visual_brief.subject: persistent background agents and governed ongoing work
verified_context: OpenAI describes Dots as persistent agents with their own cloud computers that can keep several projects moving in the background.
The engineering significance is the control plane around ongoing work: permissions, background-action limits, approval boundaries, auditability, and interruption.
The illustration must represent persistence and governed access without depicting literal software interfaces, robots, credentials, or security claims.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: Persistent delegated work continues along different paths while a governed destination remains the stable control point.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Two architectural paths cross a rugged landscape toward one stable gateway, turning ongoing delegated work and governed convergence into a physical editorial metaphor.

candidate_notes.A: Rejected before scoring: robotic work arms make the scene too literal and violate the constitution's robot prohibition.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant layered workrooms and thresholds. Strong physical presence, but secondary detail competes with the persistence metaphor at thumbnail size.
candidate_notes.C: Selected and user-approved replacement generated from the canonical Visual Constitution and Illustration System. The final artwork uses architectural paths, a single governed destination, warm paper texture, restrained terracotta, and no text, logos, UI, or robots.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 1600 × 900 wide hero preserves both architectural paths, the shared destination, the terracotta emphasis, and enough landscape context for the metaphor to remain spacious.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered narrow crop retains the governed destination and meaningful portions of both paths without depending on fine detail.
crop_review.reference_layout: The physical architectural mass, paper texture, controlled perspective, warm negative space, and restrained terracotta keep the artwork editorial rather than schematic.
crop_review.thumbnail: At small scale the contrasting paths and shared destination remain a strong, recognizable silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared palette, warm paper field, graphite restraint, terracotta emphasis, architectural mass, negative space, physical depth, focal hierarchy, and thumbnail silhouette against the current production reference set.
